verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs say you can send manual and automatic invoices with flexible payment methods from the dashboard. The Accounts Receivable API lets you create invoices, collect by card or ACH debit, track when each is paid, and download invoice PDFs. Invoice volume is plan-gated (500/month on Plus, unlimited on Pro). Missing for 10: any evidence of invoice branding or customization (logo, colors, templates), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the invoicing and payment-collection experience.
